about_the_game:
Step back into the late '90s with God Help Us All, a fixed-camera horror western game that will test your will to survive.

In this chilling experience, you'll play as Onacona, an albino bounty hunter returning to the isolated town of Los Cuervos. A mysterious sickness is spreading through the arid lands, turning the locals into something monstrous. It's up to you to uncover the truth before it's too late.

Inspired by the golden age of survival horror, God Help Us All features are:

  • Classic Survival Gameplay: Navigate the terrifying town of Los Cuervos and its surroundings with limited resources and a fixed-camera perspective that keeps you on edge. Every corner could hide a new threat.

  • Old-School Pre-Rendered Backgrounds: Immerse yourself in the gritty, unsettling atmosphere of a forgotten era. The stunning pre-rendered backgrounds bring the haunting world to life, making every location feel both beautiful and dangerous.

  • Weapon Upgrades: Use parts and improve your weapons to stand a fighting chance against the horrors that await. Will you be able to fend off the spreading evil, or will you become a victim of the sickness?

  • Wild West Grittiness: The unforgiving landscape of the Wild West adds a unique layer of tension to this survival horror game. Get ready to face the darkest secrets of Los Cuervos.ç

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of gun violence and graphic content. It also explores religious themes, blending horror with elements of Christianity and figures like Jesus.
